stored.fact: internal/llmprompts holds every LLM prompt and LLM-facing instruction both apps send; it is not internal/prompts (the P246 popup router).
registry.go is the one file with prompt text; each entry has id, kind, apps, title/purpose/usedBy catalog keys, applies-when, default, required fragments and fixed output schema.

Saving the default text of a prompt removes its override; override text must be 1 byte to 32 KiB.
